title: MPK Qwen3 0.6B Snapshot-Pointer Patch Smoke
command: cd tmp/baselines/mirage-mpk && apply local RuntimeConfig::paged_kv_indices_snapshot pointer patch, then HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 python demo/qwen3/demo.py --model Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --max-new-tokens 1 --max-seq-length 128 --max-num-batched-requests 1 --max-num-batched-tokens 1 --ignore-eos --use-mirage --output-dir ../../cuda-backend/paper-baselines/mpk/patched-snapshot-pointer/token1_nosan/build --save-tokens ../../cuda-backend/paper-baselines/mpk/patched-snapshot-pointer/token1_nosan/tokens.json
observation: Assigning meta_tensors[10] to RuntimeConfig::paged_kv_indices_snapshot in the local MPK clone clears the previous scheduler null-write symptom for the smallest Qwen3-0.6B persistent run; the run exits 0 and saves token output.
blocker: The result is still partial because it depends on a local patch in the ignored MPK baseline clone; the patch must be upstreamed or carried as an explicit reproducibility patch before paper-grade MPK rows can be imported.
